entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: The largest city on Ikoria, a fortified human sanctuary protected by walls and the Argalith, destroyed by Lukka during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: The plane where Drannith stood.

entities.name: Argalith
entities.description: A gigantic green crystal pillar, the largest single crystal on the plane and foundation of Drannith's magical defenses.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A Coppercoat Specials leader who bonds with Leori, later a planeswalker who destroys Drannith, then returns compleated.

entities.name: Leori
entities.description: A patagia tiger who bonds with Lukka and is killed by Kudro.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: Lukka's fiancee and General Kudro's daughter, who later leads Drannith and relaxes its anti-monster stance.

entities.name: General Kudro
entities.description: General of the Coppercoats and Drannith's leader, who executes Leori and is killed by Lukka.

entities.name: Gox
entities.description: A Coppercoat killed by Leori.

entities.name: Gedra
entities.description: A Coppercoat killed by Leori.

entities.name: Nik
entities.description: A Coppercoat killed by Leori.

entities.name: Epha
entities.description: A Coppercoat who fled from Leori.

entities.name: Yidaro
entities.description: A monster in Lukka's horde.

entities.name: Barrow
entities.description: A bonder who aided in Drannith's defense.

entities.name: Brin
entities.description: A bonder who aided in Drannith's defense.

entities.name: Coppercoats
entities.description: Drannith's most well-resourced military force, whose General also leads the city.

entities.name: Copper Host
entities.description: Phyrexian monstrosities led by compleated Lukka who overwhelmed Drannith.

entities.name: Ozolith
entities.description: A power source Lukka drew on to gather monsters, until it shattered.

entities.name: Savai
entities.description: The lowlands where Drannith stood and where Lukka fled.

entities.name: Lavabrink
entities.description: Where Drannith's survivors fled.

entities.name: Snapdax
entities.description: A monster whose attacks, in myth, forced survivors to build the fortified city.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Drannith was destroyed.

events.summary: In 4561 AR a nightmare and then Leori attack Drannith; Leori kills Coppercoats but a bond rises between her and Lukka.
events.quote: a sudden bond rising between them stopped them both in their tracks

events.summary: Kudro orders Lukka confined, but Jirina helps him escape Drannith into Savai.
events.quote: Jirina Kudro helped him escape Drannith and flee into Savai

events.summary: Leori returns to Drannith with Jirina and is shot down by ballistae, then shackled at the wall.
events.quote: She was shot down and wounded

events.summary: General Kudro executes Leori himself, and Lukka feels the bond sever.
events.quote: felt the bond being severed as Leori died

events.summary: Lukka gathers monsters with the Ozolith, kills Kudro with a trap, and besieges Drannith.
events.quote: personally killed Kudro by stabbing him in the heart

events.summary: The Ozolith shatters, igniting Lukka's spark and sending him away, so the monsters wander off.
events.quote: causing his planeswalker spark to ignite, sending him away from Ikoria

events.summary: The compleated Lukka and the Copper Host reduce Drannith to rubble, and survivors flee to Lavabrink.
events.quote: the city was reduced to rubble

he confessed to feeling a bond with the huge flying cat
